settings.heading: Trade prices for trades.
settings.intro: Builders, tilers, plumbers and renovators save on every order — tiles, bathroomware, tapware and accessories. Apply once, log in, and your prices show automatically.

settings.heading: Before you apply.
settings.text: Anything else? Call or email the team.

settings.question: Who can apply?
settings.answer: Any business with an active ABN buying for work — tilers, builders, plumbers, renovators, designers and property developers.

settings.question: How do I see my trade prices?
settings.answer: Once approved, log in using the email address on your application. Every product then shows your trade price, and the discount applies automatically in the cart and at checkout.

settings.question: Can I combine trade pricing with other offers?
settings.answer: Trade pricing is our best price, so it doesn't stack with other discount codes. Free shipping on small items still applies.

settings.question: Can you deliver to site?
settings.answer: Yes — within the Perth metro area for tiles and large items. Small items ship Australia-wide. You can also collect from Maddington by appointment.
